description: Team deliverables bulletin board with GitHub as backend storage

backend.description: Using GitHub API to store and retrieve deliverables, tasks, and conversations

authentication.description: Users authenticate with their GitHub accounts for access control

features.admin_panel: Post messages and tasks with attachments
features.architect_view: Read bulletin, self-assign or be assigned tasks
features.task_management: Track tasks with statuses: New, Assigned-InProgress, Closed
